symbols.name: tintin_upload_actor_tiles_0_to_3
symbols.description: Upload four tile descriptors from DE42 into actor slot + 00. Tail continuation: saved VRAM-bank AF must already be on the guest stack.

symbols.name: tintin_upload_actor_tiles_4_to_7
symbols.description: Upload four tile descriptors from DE4E into actor slot + 40. Tail continuation; entered through the upload dispatcher.

symbols.name: tintin_upload_actor_tiles_8_to_11
symbols.description: Upload four tile descriptors from DE5A into actor slot + 80. Tail continuation; entered through the upload dispatcher.

symbols.name: tintin_upload_actor_tiles_12_to_15
symbols.description: Upload four tile descriptors from DE66 into actor slot + C0. Tail continuation; entered through the upload dispatcher.

symbols.name: tintin_upload_actor_tile_quarter
symbols.description: Save VRAM bank, select bank 1, dispatch one four-tile batch by DF72 & 7F. See research/graphics.md and graphics_reference.c.

symbols.name: tintin_stage_actor_frame
symbols.description: When upload phase is zero, stage bank-9 frame metadata and 16 tile descriptors, then continue layout setup. See research/animation.md.

symbols.name: tintin_select_actor_frame_id
symbols.description: Map animation state, use phase and bank-9 relative sequence table to select DF73/DF74 frame ID; leave ROM bank 1 selected.
